definition: Ian J. Goodfellow (born 1987) is an American computer scientist, engineer, and executive, most noted for his work on artificial neural networks and deep learning.
details: He was a research scientist at Google DeepMind, was previously employed as a research scientist at Google Brain, and director of machine learning at Apple, as well as one of the first employees at OpenAI. He has made several important contributions to the field of deep learning, including the invention of the generative adversarial network (GAN). Goodfellow co-wrote, as the first author, the textbook Deep Learning (2016) and wrote the chapter on deep learning in the authoritative textbook of the field of artificial intelligence, Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (used in more than 1,500 universities in 135 countries).

explainer.lead: Ian Goodfellow is an American machine learning researcher who invented generative adversarial networks (GANs), pioneered work on adversarial examples and co-wrote the textbook Deep Learning.
explainer.knownFor: Inventing generative adversarial networks (GANs), the first deep learning method to generate convincing images.

contributions.name: Generative adversarial networks
contributions.detail: His 2014 paper trains a generator against a discriminator; GANs launched the modern era of AI image generation.

contributions.name: Adversarial examples
contributions.detail: “Explaining and Harnessing Adversarial Examples” showed tiny input changes can fool networks and introduced the fast gradient sign method.

contributions.name: The Deep Learning textbook
contributions.detail: Co-wrote the 2016 MIT Press textbook with Yoshua Bengio and Aaron Courville.

contributions.name: Street View transcription
contributions.detail: At Google, built a system that reads house numbers from Street View photos to place addresses on Google Maps.

timeline.what: PhD in machine learning, Université de Montréal, under Yoshua Bengio and Aaron Courville
Deep Learning textbook published; joins OpenAI as one of its first employees
Joins Apple as director of machine learning
Leaves Apple over its return-to-office policy and joins DeepMind
